name: xplainer
description: Turn a bug, a root cause, or an architecture decision into a short narrated explainer video with captions, rendered to one MP4. Rendering uses Remotion: depending on the size of your company and how you use it, you may need your own Remotion licence — see https://remotion.pro/license.

interface.shortDescription: Explain anything as a narrated video
interface.longDescription: Build short explainer videos from inside the session: animated Remotion scenes, a synthesised voiceover, and word-level captions rendered together into one MP4. The tools run on your own machine, against a local xplainer runtime that renders every frame and keeps every file there.
defaultPrompt: Explain this bug as a ninety-second video
Turn this architecture decision into an explainer
Make a video showing what this fix actually changes
